notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Marvin using Cryptic Trilobite's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Activate Marvin using Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping Marvin, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Activate Marvin using Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
